messages:
Alex: @support Customer report: after they split their org the child account shows 0 free credits via the API, but the Console dashboard shows 1,500 on the parent. Customer also says tokens were charged to the child yesterday. Can we triage?

Maria: Can you paste the org IDs and a quick curl that reproduces the 0? Any ledger IDs or invoices handy?

Alex: Repro (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/credits?org_id=child-123"
# response: {"free_credits":0,"granted_credits":0}
```
Dashboard screenshot shows 1500 free credits on parent org `parent-456`. Invoice INV-2026-8743 shows charges for tokens on child-123 that weren't offset.

Sophie: tagging BillingBot — migration jobs can be flaky. BillingBot, any migration job logs around that split time? :eyes:

BillingBot: Automated: migration job `org-split-migrate-v2` completed 2026-02-10T08:12:03Z. No terminal errors recorded.

Maria: Can you dump ledger events for child-123 between 2026-02-10T07:50 and 2026-02-10T08:30? Looking for `credit_transfer` / `grant` / `consumption` entries.

Jared: Pulled ledger: found `grant` events for 1500 credits, but `owner_id` set to `parent-456`. Found `consumption` events for the same tokens attributed to `child-123`. Also a `credit_reservation` that later became `consumed` with a mismatched owner. There was a 409 conflict from `migrate-service` at 08:11:59Z. Likely race where migration wrote grants to parent while consumption attribution stayed with child.

Alex: Repro steps for customer (what we ran):
1) create org split via Console UI (parent-456 / child-123)
2) call credits endpoint for child -> returns 0
3) call usage endpoint -> shows yesterday's tokens charged under child
4) check invoice -> no credit applied
Logs show a `409 conflict` in `migrate-service` around 08:11:59Z.

Sophie: OK that matches a migration window race we saw in staging. Root cause: migration wrote `credit_grant` rows with wrong owner_id when the `owner` reconciliation ran concurrently. Action: open billing ticket, reassign grants, and patch migration to be atomic.

Maria: Patch status?

Sophie: PR #3421 updates `org-split-migrate` to use a DB transaction and single `owner_id` source of truth. Also add row-locking on `credit_grants`. Will canary deploy to billing-staging at 09:30 PT then to prod after 1h soak.

BillingBot: Note: `migration-reassign` script requires manual approval. rollback_safe flag: false.

Jared: Ran manual reassign script on prod with audit mode then live: `/scripts/reassign_credits.sh --from parent-456 --to child-123 --match split_event=2003050000`. It moved 1500 credits and created audit note `reassign:2003056789`. I also created an invoice adjustment INV-2026-8743-ADJ to credit the charges back.

Alex: Customer confirms child-123 now shows 1500 free credits and invoice adjusted. They verified recent token usage was credited.

Sophie: Follow-up items: add regression test for org-split race, alert in billing when `consumption.owner_id != grant.owner_id` for same tokens, and postmortem doc. Filed BILL-789, assigned to Jared.

Maria: :thumbsup: Monitoring for 24h then close. Thanks everyone. :party:

Alex: Thanks team — please ping me if anything else pops up.
